title: Cost: full-record processing and one weekly run
method: Spend recorded by every run, in USD at the configured rates
definition: One row per run and spend kind, in USD at the configured rates: the runs that processed the full record into the current store, and every run of one weekly cycle (acquisition and processing, the edition writing pass, the daily feed polls of the week). summary.csv holds the totals and the weekly chain's graph-host hours (a compute cost not in these ledgers).
notes: Model names are not carried in this figure's files.
